svg.title: Khazad-dûm — an imagined dwarven survey
svg.desc: A detailed pen-and-ink west–east cutaway of Moria, with seven terraces of halls, branching mines, a great chasm and an underground lake. Orc patrols, a cave troll, a drummer, and the Balrog confronting Gandalf appear as small ink vignettes. Architectural forms, scenes and passage positions are artistic reconstructions.
svg.text: An imagined survey of the mountain realm

g.title: Orc patrols among the abandoned halls
A hunched Orc drummer in the deep halls
A cave troll, stooped beneath the gallery roof
Durin’s Bane, a shadow wreathed in fire, facing Gandalf

svg.text: Beneath the roots of the mountains
